prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 52.5 °C (69% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 57.3 °C (59% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 58.7 °C (51% above healthy). Thermal equilibrium is compromised, causing fluid temperature to rise well above nominal operating limits.
Valve: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 9.40 s (within 1% of healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.83 s (within 1% of healthy). Valve switching latency remains tightly within normal healthy tolerances.
Pump leakage: weak leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.33 l/min (4% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 375 W·min/l (2% below healthy); SE system efficiency factor 57.6 % (within 2% of healthy). Slight elevation in power-to-flow ratio reflects incipient volumetric efficiency loss.
Accumulator: close to total failure. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 45.3 bar (3% below healthy). Marked pressure ripple and reduced peak pressure indicate severe loss of hydraulic accumulator gas pre-charge.

tslm_prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 52.6 °C (69% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 57.0 °C (59% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 58.4 °C (50% above healthy). Rapid temperature accumulation with minimal inlet-outlet drop indicates loss of cooling circulation.
Valve: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 9.39 s (within 1% of healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.85 s (within 1% of healthy). Sharp pressure transient and immediate switching between sensors indicate optimal valve response.
Pump leakage: no leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.59 l/min (within 1% of healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 363 W·min/l (5% below healthy). Flow delivery and motor electrical consumption match expected volumetric efficiency without leakage.
Accumulator: severely reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 45.5 bar (2% below healthy). Pressure buffering is largely ineffective due to compromised pre-charge pressure in the accumulator.
